# Sparkle AI

> Privacy-first Windows clipboard assistant with local Ollama and optional BYOK cloud providers.

Sparkle AI analyzes user-selected clipboard text or, after explicit session consent, debounced
clipboard changes. Local Ollama is the default. Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude are
optional, user-selected cloud routes with in-memory credentials and visible provider state.

## Canonical documentation

- README.md: product boundary, setup, provider choices, and development workflow
- docs/privacy.md: capture modes, cloud transmission, credential handling, and retention
- docs/architecture.md: application and provider trust boundaries
- docs/windows-setup.md: supported local setup and troubleshooting
- SECURITY.md: vulnerability reporting and security boundaries

## Safety boundary

The application has no autonomous tools, filesystem authority, telemetry, hosted backend, or
persistent credential store. Clipboard text is untrusted and secret detection is heuristic.
